description: Fixed, hand-authored distractor bank for the Tier-2 controlled injection benchmark. Every entry is a fixed string written by hand; no model sampling is involved. Entries are deliberately neutral: no kinship or family terms, no personal names used by the injected pairs, no register pronouns (tu/tum/aap, du/Sie/Ihr/dein), and no city, weekday, month or country values that appear in any QA answer. validate_tier2.py enforces this mechanically.
